title: Edgewise Envelopes Between Balanced Forman and Ollivier-Ricci Curvature
abstract: arXiv:2603.13535v5 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Evaluating Ollivier-Ricci (OR) curvature on large-scale graphs is computationally prohibitive due to the necessity of solving an optimal transport problem for every edge. We bypass this bottleneck by deriving explicit, two-sided, piecewise-affine transfer moduli between the transport-based OR curvature and the combinatorial Balanced Forman (BF) curvature. We establish deterministic bounds for $\mathfrak{c}_{\rm OR}(i,j)$ parameterized by 2-hop local graph combinatorics, reducing the edgewise evaluation complexity from an optimal transport linear program to a worst-case $\mathcal{O}\left(\max_{v \in V} \operatorname{deg}(v)^{2.5}\right)$ time, entirely eliminating the reliance on global solvers. Empirical scalability benchmarks confirm these theoretical guarantees, demonstrating that the proposed transfer moduli yield significant asymptotic and constant-factor speedups over the steep polynomial scaling of exact OR evaluation. Furthermor

translated_title: 平衡Forman曲率与Ollivier-Ricci曲率之间的逐边包络界
translated_abstract: 在大规模图上计算Ollivier-Ricci（OR）曲率在计算上是极其昂贵的，因为需要为每条边求解一个最优传输问题。我们通过推导基于传输的OR曲率与组合式的平衡Forman（BF）曲率之间的显式、双侧、分段仿射转移模（transfer moduli）来绕过这一瓶颈。我们建立了以2跳局部图组合结构为参数的 $\mathfrak{c}_{\rm OR}(i,j)$ 的确定性界，将逐边评估的复杂度从最优传输线性规划降低到最坏情况下 $\mathcal{O}\left(\max_{v \in V} \operatorname{deg}(v)^{2.5}\right)$ 的时间，完全消除了对全局求解器的依赖。经验可扩展性基准测试证实了这些理论保证，表明所提出的转移模相比精确OR计算的陡峭多项式扩展提供了显著的渐近加速和常数因子加速。此外……
tldr: 该论文通过推导平衡Forman曲率与Ollivier-Ricci曲率之间的显式双侧分段仿射界，将图上OR曲率的逐边计算从最优传输线性规划降至最坏情况O(最大度^2.5)时间，大幅提升大规模图上曲率计算的效率。
en_tdlr: This paper derives explicit two-sided piecewise-affine transfer moduli between Balanced Forman and Ollivier-Ricci curvature, reducing edgewise OR curvature computation from optimal transport linear programs to worst-case O(max degree^2.5) time for significant speedups on large-scale graphs.
